title: outputs/analytics.json — written by the spend-analyst's scripts (TODO #2)
description: Named, reproducible risk indicators computed by Python from the spend workbooks and contracts.csv. Every number here was printed by a script; the model never computes one. Full flagged lists go to outputs/analytics-full/ (see contract/files.md). The risk-assessor and planner cite values here by JSON path, e.g. [metric:$.tests.duplicates.different_time.groups], so keep paths stable and leaves scalar.

scripts.description: The scripts that produced this file, e.g. ["scripts/clean.py", "scripts/analyse.py"].

excluded.description: One entry per exclusion category: rows, £ and a one-line reason.

tags.description: One entry per tag (general_procurement, care_or_education_placement, grant, agency_staff, premises_non_procurement).

thresholds.description: Derived from rules.json, never typed. One entry per distinct threshold.

skipped.description: Every test or tier not run, with why (e.g. a parameter in rules.json is null). Skipping is honest; guessing is a failure.

contracts.description: What was loaded from contracts.csv, the filters applied, warnings (e.g. the export cap) and the caveat that a missing notice is not evidence of off-contract spend.

matching.description: Supplier-matching counts per class (exact, near_ratio, near_contain, none).

test.description: A test either ran (parameters + rule_ids + counts, £ totals, a top 20 and the analytics-full file it wrote) or was skipped with a reason.
